authority: A Grammar Playbook by GSR — latest recovered master sources

sourceIntegrity.policy: preserve gaps; never invent or silently renumber

buildRule: Do not create final application data from generated assumptions. Reconcile authoritative lesson records first, preserve source text, and mark unavailable evidence as a source gap.

bundleMapping.rule: Bundles and modules may organize lessons, but must not alter lesson identity, numbering, source text, or source-gap status.
